originalTitle: Pinterest Just Gained 20% in a Month: Take Profits, or Buy More?
summary: Key TakeawaysPinterest stock is up 20% in the past month through Monday’s close, while the S&P 500 rose less than 1% and Snap gained 13%. The stock bounced off a September low near the price Pinterest paid to buy back its own shares, and two social-media rallies carried it higher in October.
content:
Pinterest ( PINS ) stock is up 20% in the past month (through Monday’s close), while the S&P 500 rose 0.6% and the Nasdaq 100 slipped 0.4%. Snap ( SNAP ) gained 13% over the same stretch.

The strange part? Pinterest hasn’t put out a new quarterly number since early August.

A September low, then an October run

The month started from a rough spot. Pinterest dropped 9% on Sept. 9 after CEO Bill Ready warned at a Goldman Sachs conference that the international business was under pressure, from new EU limits on Asia-based cross-border sellers and from a reshuffle of how it sells overseas. The slide went on through a 5% drop on Sept. 22, with no news behind it.

But it ran out of steam at an interesting level. Pinterest spent more than $2 billion buying back its own stock this year through early August, at an average price of $18.17, and the shares bottomed in September just above that .

Then October did all the work: the stock climbed 20% from Sept. 30 to Oct. 15 . Snap jumped 7% on Oct. 9 as social-media stocks rallied together, and Pinterest rose 4.2%. The group rallied again on Oct. 13, and Pinterest added 4.4%. Two days later it gained another 4.4% as UBS kept its Buy rating and $33 target.

The only real company news came on Oct. 5, after the close, when Pinterest named James Dibbo CFO, starting Oct. 26. At Amazon ( AMZN ) , Dibbo ran finance for Amazon Ads and Prime Video, among other businesses. The stock barely reacted, rising about 1% after hours .

I think the hire matters more than that. Ready has been blunt about where Pinterest falls short: “We 5x the number of clicks to advertisers over that last 3-year period, but we certainly didn’t 5x the revenue,” he said on the second-quarter call.

A finance chief who helped run Amazon’s ad business is a sensible pick to help close that gap.

A 20% month sounds like a lot, until you see the starting point. Pinterest’s forward P/E is 10.3x today. That’s up from a five-year low of 8.4x on Sept. 17, but far below its five-year average of 24x.

Wall Street hasn’t chased the move, either. Holds now lead the ratings, 19 against 17 Buys and 2 Outperforms, after 29 Buys and 6 Holds a year ago. And the consensus target has stayed at about $29 the whole time.

That’s still about 30% above Monday’s close, though it’s down from $44 a year ago. Plus: the stock now sits just under the roughly $22.72 conversion price on Elliott’s $1 billion of convertible notes.

Third-quarter results are due in early November, the first report with Dibbo as CFO. Pinterest guided to revenue of $1.19 billion to $1.21 billion, or 13% to 15% growth. That follows 18% in Q2, when US and Canada growth sped up five points to 18%.

Analysts still expect revenue to grow 16% this year, to $4.91 billion, and another 13% in 2027.

Nothing in October’s news should move those estimates, so it’s up to the November report.

The risk is overseas. The international business has more than 80% of Pinterest’s users but brings in only about a fifth of its revenue, and the reset there could drag on.

My take: Pinterest is still a buy at 10x forward earnings. If US and Canada growth holds near 18%, this multiple has a lot of room to rise. Of course, a miss on the guide would send the stock right back toward that $18 buyback price.

chineseTitle: Pinterest 一个月内上涨 20%：获利还是买入更多？
chineseSummary: 关键要点 截至周一收盘，Pinterest 股票在过去一个月内上涨了 20%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨了不到 1%，Snap 上涨了 13%。该股从 9 月份的低点反弹，接近 Pinterest 回购其股票的价格，并且 10 月份的两次社交媒体反弹带动该股走高。
chineseContent:
Pinterest (PINS) 股票过去一个月上涨了 20%（截至周一收盘），而标准普尔 500 指数上涨 0.6%，纳斯达克 100 指数下跌 0.4%。 Snap (SNAP) 同期上涨 13%。

奇怪的部分？自 8 月初以来，Pinterest 尚未发布新的季度数据。

九月低点，然后十月上涨

这个月从一个艰难的时刻开始。 9 月 9 日，Pinterest 股价下跌 9%，此前首席执行官 Bill Ready 在高盛会议上警告称，由于欧盟对亚洲跨境卖家的新限制以及海外销售方式的重新调整，国际业务面临压力。 9 月 22 日，该股继续下跌 5%，但背后没有任何消息。

但它在一个有趣的水平上失去了动力。截至 8 月初，Pinterest 花费超过 20 亿美元回购自己的股票，平均价格为 18.17 美元，9 月份股价触底，略高于该价格。

然后 10 月份完成了所有工作：该股从 9 月 30 日到 10 月 15 日上涨了 20%。随着社交媒体股票集体上涨，10 月 9 日 Snap 上涨 7%，Pinterest 上涨 4.2%。该集团于 10 月 13 日再次反弹，Pinterest 上涨 4.4%。两天后，由于瑞银维持买入评级和 33 美元的目标，该股又上涨 4.4%。

TIKR 在 Pinterest 上追踪 39 名分析师。有多少人说“买”？

一站式查看 Pinterest 上的买入、持有和卖出评级的完整细目，以及华尔街的收入和盈利预测。超过 500,000 名投资者使用 TIKR 来研究此类股票。查看 Pinterest 的分析师评级

唯一真正的公司新闻是在 10 月 5 日收盘后发布的，当时 Pinterest 任命 James Dibbo 为首席财务官，从 10 月 26 日开始。在亚马逊 (AMZN)，Dibbo 负责亚马逊广告和 Prime Video 等业务的财务工作。该股几乎没有做出反应，盘后上涨约 1%。

我认为雇佣比这更重要。 Ready 直言不讳地谈到了 Pinterest 的不足之处：“在过去 3 年期间，我们为广告商带来的点击量增加了 5 倍，但我们的收入肯定没有增加 5 倍，”他在第二季度的电话会议上表示。

帮助运营亚马逊广告业务的财务主管是帮助缩小这一差距的明智选择。

每月 20% 听起来似乎很多，直到您看到起点为止。 Pinterest 目前的远期市盈率为 10.3 倍。这高于 9 月 17 日 8.4 倍的五年低点，但远低于 24 倍的五年平均水平。

华尔街也没有追随这一举措。继一年前 29 名买入和 6 名持有之后，现在评级领先，其中 19 名评级为“买入”，17 名评级为“买入”，2 名评级为跑赢大盘。而共识目标始终保持在 29 美元左右。

尽管低于一年前的 44 美元，但仍比周一收盘价高出约 30%。另外：该股目前的价格略低于 Elliott 10 亿美元可转换票据的大约 22.72 美元的转换价格。

第三季度业绩将于 11 月初发布，这是 Dibbo 担任首席财务官的第一份报告。 Pinterest 预计收入为 11.9 亿美元至 12.1 亿美元，即增长 13% 至 15%。此前第二季度，美国和加拿大的经济增长加快了 5 个百分点，达到 18%，增长了 18%。

分析师仍预计今年收入将增长 16%，达到 49.1 亿美元，2027 年再增长 13%。

10 月份的新闻不会改变这些估计，所以这取决于 11 月份的报告。

风险在海外。国际业务拥有 Pinterest 80% 以上的用户，但只带来了约五分之一的收入，而且该业务的重置可能会拖延下去。

我的看法：Pinterest 仍以 10 倍的预期市盈率买入。如果美国和加拿大的增长率保持在 18% 附近，这个倍数还有很大的上升空间。当然，如果不遵守指南，股票就会回到 18 美元的回购价格。
